patch_description: Bias proposed mutations toward vertices involved in the currently smallest triangles. The minimum-area objective is controlled by a small active set of constraints; uniformly selecting a point wastes most iterations moving points that cannot improve the bottleneck. The added helper identifies vertices appearing in the 18 smallest triangles and assigns them higher sampling probability, while retaining a nonzero probability for every point to avoid premature trapping. This is especially useful during annealing, where repair moves should predominantly affect active near-degenerate triples.
